title: Freeweights catalog
description: A catalog row is one entry: a model, a dataset or a tool. Its key is (kind, id), because model and dataset ids collide at the source; kind is stored, never inferred from the section. The catalog file is {sections, models}.

kind.description: Part of the key with id. Stored, not inferred from the section.

relation.description: Lineage. A quant or adapter attaches to its parent as a Variants row.

parent.description: id of the parent entry; null for a base.

tier.description: Inclusion tier (policy/inclusion-policy.md). Absent or null for entries curated before tiers.

signals.description: Popularity at the last discovery run. Never used to delist.

audit.description: How the license verdict was reached. tag = the publisher's own license tag, shown as "license as declared by the publisher".

tasks.description: Task tags such as text-generation, embedding, text-to-speech.

formats.description: Weight formats for models, data formats for datasets. Empty for link-only entries with no file listing (gated datasets).

base_model.description: id of the base model, if this is a derivative.

manifest_url.description: Absent for From-source-only rows that have no manifest.

publisher_logo.description: Added by the API (/api/catalog), not stored in catalog.json: absolute URL of the publisher's logo as the site serves it. Absent when there is none.

requires_terms.description: True when the user must accept the license or gate terms before download.

license_class.description: permissive and custom rows are hosted (signed manifest); gated, territory, non-commercial and unreviewed rows are link only (From the publisher).

link_reason.description: Why a row is link only (From the publisher, no manifest): the license needs acceptance at the source, covers only some countries, is non-commercial, or no person has read it yet.

license_terms.description: Terms a hosted entry passes on with its files: OpenMDW notices, the LFM revenue limit, the OpenRAIL++ Attachment A use restrictions.

license_url.description: Link to the license text or gate page.
